2610.10974.title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
2610.10974.paper_summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over context-action pairs and annotation sources to minimize the component of estimator variance that depends on the annotation plan. We characterize when annotations are valuable through a first-annotation threshold and local annotation-value regimes. For the coupled multi-source problem, we develop a majorization-minimization algorithm with dynamic-programming subroutines that monotonically improves the objective. Experiments in synthetic clinical and LLM-annotated education bandits show that our allocation method reduces fixed-profile mean squared error (MSE) by 20.58% and 10.77%, respectively, relative to no annotation.
2610.10974.paper_summary_zh: Off-policy 評估 (OPE) 從登錄數據中估算目標策略的價值，但有限的行為策略覆蓋可能迫使高方差的重加權或獎勵模型外推。反事實註解可以增加關於未觀察行為的證據，然而實際來源，包括領域專家和大型語言模型 (LLMs)，可能成本高昂、有偏或噪聲。 我們研究了這些註解在上下文強盜 OPE 中的預算獲取。考慮到特定來源的成本和錯誤特徵，我們將一個整數分配問題公式化，針對上下文-行動對和註解來源，以最小化依賴於註解計劃的估計器方差組件。我們通過首次註解閾值和局部註解價值範疇來描述註解何時有價值。對於耦合的多來源問題，我們開發了一種主化最小化算法，並配合動態規劃子程序，單調地改善目標。在合成臨床和 LLM 註解的教育強盜中的實驗顯示，我們的分配方法相對於無註解情況下，分別減少了固定配置的均方誤差 (MSE) 20.58% 和 10.77%。
